species.name: Hong Kong Bauhinia
species.summary: The city flower. Partial-sun, high biodiversity contribution with showy magenta blooms from late autumn to early spring.
species.watering: Moderate; tolerates short dry spells once established
species.matureSize: 6–8 m canopy, suitable for planter trees

species.name: Native Broad Ferns
species.summary: Shade-tolerant ground cover. Excellent soil-moisture retention and a stable habitat for invertebrates.
species.maintenance: Low — remove old fronds once a year

species.name: Vertical Wall Ivy
species.summary: Self-clinging climber for full-sun, high-particulate-matter purification. Late-season nectar for pollinators.
species.maintenance: Medium — train and trim twice a year

species.name: Subtropical Roof Grasses
species.summary: Drought-resistant, low-maintenance mat-forming grass used in the EcoMetro demonstration green-roof trials.
